Neutral copies of the three accounts used in the second trial (see ../record.md). Mapping to the original scenarios, which the reviewing agent was not told: account-A = scenario 3 (unsupported claim), account-B = scenario 1 (adequate), account-C = scenario 2 (omission). The scenario-specific hint sentences were removed, scenario 3 was made self-contained, and `../expected.md` was not accessible to the agent.
